data.body: Interim live-outage findings at 2026-09-08T00:56Z: review-bot container is currently running and Docker-healthy on the host, but it is not functionally healthy. Journald shows repeated Gerrit webhook POST /webhook requests from the Gerrit container returning 401 Unauthorized and the backfill reconciler emitting RECONCILE_DEGRADED events-log HTTP 401 every 5 minutes. This matches the post-rotation bad-secret-pickup hypothesis: the process liveness / /health checks remain green while Gerrit auth/webhook auth is broken, so no LLM-Review votes are cast. I am continuing restoration by comparing secret fingerprints/config without printing secrets.
